purpose: One deduplicated portfolio view of unfinished LAiDIES ideas and build obligations. It complements, and never replaces, the complete source census and product backlogs.
truthRule: Status records evidence truth; priority records sequencing; disposition records the build obligation. CAPTURED, SPECIFIED and BUILT LOCALLY never mean public or complete.

items.title: Homepage and Town Entry information architecture
items.currentTruth: A design lane exists, but Ali has not accepted a final coherent Homepage and rejected reorganizations must not be revived.
items.nextAction: Return to the last accepted visual direction; preserve the approved masthead, four clear sections and Daily Buzz rail; complete responsive, language, link and visual review before any release claim.
items.doneWhen: Ali accepts the exact desktop/mobile candidate and all navigation, account-state, content-truth, accessibility and public verification gates pass.
ideaLogClusters: Rewind Era / dial-up to downloads / immersive learning philosophy

items.title: Building-by-building experience completion
items.currentTruth: All canonical buildings have stewards, but readiness and visual maturity differ materially and many intended journeys remain held.
items.nextAction: Work through one building/function at a time while shared systems remain separately owned; close content, frontend, backend, responsive, accessibility and release gates for each.
items.doneWhen: Every building has an accepted intended experience, truthful availability, complete visitor journeys and exact public release evidence.

items.title: Experience-flexible learning pathways
items.buildingOrFunction: Learning System across High, LIBRAiRY, episodes, tools and Closet
items.currentTruth: The site has scattered beginner/advanced references but no owned system for different knowledge, job context or desired depth.
items.nextAction: Define the four support modes, metadata contract, discovery treatment and voluntary domain-specific preference rules; pilot them on one class and its related book, episode and tool.
items.doneWhen: Every substantial learning item states assumed knowledge, useful outcome, depth choices and next step, and representative users can find an appropriate route without being permanently graded or labelled.
ideaLogSections: Learning that meets women where they are

items.title: Get the Best Out of Your AI Tool masterclass
items.currentTruth: Research and a seven-lesson pathway exist; no lesson is scripted, filmed, admitted or public.
items.nextAction: Reconcile the class catalogue and experience-level pilot, then commission the lesson briefs, Try-Ons, assessments, complement links and production sequence.
items.doneWhen: The seven lessons form a verified practical pathway using one safe real project, with current product claims, exercises, assessment and related content.
ideaLogSections: Masterclass — Get the Best Out of Your AI Tool

items.title: Classes catalogue, curriculum and AIDB Summer Adventure patterns
items.currentTruth: Thirty-seven class previews and useful external-program patterns are recorded, but the complete catalogue, real lesson bodies and progression have not been reconciled.
items.nextAction: Inventory every proposed class, merge duplicates, apply the experience-flexible metadata and select the smallest launch set with complete materials rather than more previews.
items.doneWhen: A truthful catalogue exposes only complete classes, preserves later ideas with triggers and connects each class to its concepts, practice, episodes, books and current evidence.

items.title: Content opportunity work-order and review pipeline
items.currentTruth: Machine-checked work orders and blocker resolution exist locally, but open owner builds still prevent end-to-end evidence that recommendations consistently become released content.
items.nextAction: Complete the current work orders through artifact build, independent review, relationship/index update, release and public discovery receipts.
items.doneWhen: A material signal can produce a news item, concept/book/class/episode update, song/daily derivative decision and public discovery without an orphan recommendation or silent block.

items.title: The Daily as a complete SUNNYVAiLE newspaper
items.buildingOrFunction: NewsStand with Homepage Daily Buzz preview
items.currentTruth: The complete-newspaper direction is captured; the Homepage rail is only a preview and must not substitute for the paper.
items.nextAction: Design and build the newspaper information architecture for sourced AI reporting, Paige's tip, Promptoscope, Mme CLAi-O reading, song, town notes and clearly labelled fictional sections.
items.doneWhen: The full paper works on desktop/mobile, preserves source truth and corrections, and the Homepage rail displays today's information with small working routes to underlying destinations.

items.title: Daily curiosity and mutual-support note
items.buildingOrFunction: The Daily with Community and LUMINAiRY inputs
items.currentTruth: The purpose and anti-cringe boundaries are captured; no column name, accepted editorial bank or rendering exists.
items.nextAction: Draft and independently review a 30-entry bank of specific curiosity, credit, invitation, advocacy and opportunity-sharing actions, then select the column name from the actual writing.
items.doneWhen: Fresh, non-repetitive daily notes are useful, original, non-condescending and render in the full paper plus its compact Homepage preview.
ideaLogSections: A daily reason to ask “why?” — and sometimes “why not?”

items.title: Fictional town newspaper sections
items.currentTruth: Funny weather, town gossip, notices and announcement-teasing ideas exist but are not yet a ruled recurring package.
items.nextAction: Write the format and labelling rules that separate fictional town fun from sourced AI reporting, then create a finite launch bank with freshness and canon review.
items.doneWhen: Readers can immediately distinguish town fiction from real reporting and the recurring sections remain funny, coherent and useful rather than filler.

items.title: Resident classifieds
items.currentTruth: Study buddies, card trades and social-plan listings are captured but identity, privacy, moderation, expiry and safe contact are not specified.
items.nextAction: Return after core community moderation and identity pass; define allowed posts, expiry, reporting, blocking, contact relay and location/privacy boundaries.
items.doneWhen: Verified residents can safely create, manage, expire and report bounded listings without exposing private contact or location data.

items.title: Daily tips, Promptoscope and related derivative feeds
items.buildingOrFunction: The Daily / Mme CLAi-O / Learning System
items.currentTruth: Derivative requirements exist, but current content must remain source-aware and the Promptoscope cannot route to unrelated card readings.
items.nextAction: Finish source-to-derivative records, separate the horoscope and card-reading jobs, and prove daily rotation, suppression and public rendering.
items.doneWhen: New or corrected knowledge can feed accurate tips and appropriate Promptoscope candidates without duplicating, contradicting or misrouting content.

items.title: Resident identity, sign-in and cross-device continuation
items.currentTruth: RLS isolation, Card/allowlisted continuation restore and account switching have public evidence on a separate exact release; magic-link entry/recovery and several native UI journeys remain held.
items.nextAction: Reconcile the verified release into active source truth and provision isolated account-entry testing for magic-link delivery, UI sign-out and Closet-native propagation.
items.doneWhen: New and returning residents can create, sign in, recover, sign out and continue across devices through the real UI with isolation, cleanup and failure proof.

items.title: Closet, progress and personal collection
items.currentTruth: Account-backed continuation has evidence, but the complete visual Closet, native add/remove controls, inventory semantics and sitewide consumers are not launch-proven together.
items.nextAction: Define the authoritative inventory categories and visitor states, complete native add/remove and cross-context tests, then align every collection consumer.
items.doneWhen: A resident can understand, add, remove, organize and resume every supported saved item and progress state across devices without false ownership claims.

items.title: Butterfly Clip earning and spending economy
items.currentTruth: The currency and ledger principles are specified; a complete authoritative earn/spend/grant/revoke/balance system is not live.
items.nextAction: Lock the earn table, redemption catalogue, anti-abuse rules, total-earned and total-spent ledger, transaction reasons and cross-product API before rewarding more actions.
items.doneWhen: Residents can earn enough through meaningful learning/community actions, see every transaction and redeem without duplicate grants, coercive loops or balance inconsistency.

items.title: Building loyalty cards, stamps, charms and badges
items.currentTruth: The metaphor and partial objects exist, but there is no complete townwide grant, display, revocation and duplicate-prevention system.
items.nextAction: Reconcile stamps, charms, badges and loyalty cards into one collection model and identify which exact meaningful outcomes grant each object.
items.doneWhen: Every collectible has one authority, clear meaning, accessible display, deterministic grant/revoke behavior and a useful relationship to the next site action.

items.title: Bring-your-people rewards and two-person rituals
items.currentTruth: Postcard rewards, BEST FRIENDS and gifting foundations are specified or partially evidenced, but the complete consented social loop is not released.
items.nextAction: Reconcile referral, gifting and postcard lifecycle with identity, consent, abuse prevention, rewards and the mutual-support culture standard.
items.doneWhen: A resident can invite or support another woman through a clear, consented action with truthful delivery, appropriate rewards and no MLM or pressure dynamics.
ideaLogClusters: Postcard rewards, BEST FRIENDS and other two-person rituals

items.title: FAiRY Plays and Butterfly Clip redemption
items.currentTruth: Plays are a registered ledger concept, but authoritative credits, use tracking and an optional Clip-to-Play exchange are not complete.
items.nextAction: Decide the safe free allowance and exchange rate only after answer-cost and success evidence; implement total granted, earned, spent and spent-on records with idempotency.
items.doneWhen: Residents can understand and audit Plays, earn or redeem them fairly, and successful uses debit exactly once while failures do not consume value.

items.title: Trading Cards packs, binder, gifting and teaching catalogue
items.currentTruth: Twenty candidate fronts were accepted and parts of gifting/metadata have evidence; backs, pack logic, catalogue admission, rewards and complete binder use remain open.
items.nextAction: Finish the card schema, backs and teaching roles, then implement deterministic packs, duplicate handling, binder, gifting, ownership and release evidence.
items.doneWhen: Cards teach accurately, have approved art/front/back, enter one authoritative catalogue and can be earned, viewed, organized and gifted without ownership or economy ambiguity.

items.title: Scholastic-style Book Fair
items.currentTruth: The Book Fair is registered and intentionally not presented as a finished store; fulfilment, catalogue, Clip redemption and free-core rules remain open.
items.nextAction: Define the educational catalogue and whether items are digital, physical or collectible; bind price/Clip cost, stock, fulfilment, rights, returns and accessibility before designing the storefront.
items.doneWhen: The Book Fair offers real, deliverable, non-coercive learning objects without paywalling core literacy or promising unavailable rewards.

items.title: Resident messaging and community rooms
items.currentTruth: Some chat/account plumbing has public evidence on a separate release, while discoverability, notifications, moderation, blocking and complete resident UX remain unresolved.
items.nextAction: Reconcile the verified service, then build message visibility, unread state, reporting/blocking, moderation operations, privacy and mobile journeys into the Sorority House and Closet surfaces.
items.doneWhen: Residents can find, send, receive, manage and report messages through a safe intuitive interface, with clear notification and moderation behavior.

items.title: What is everyone reading? room and future book club
items.currentTruth: The prompt and book-club expansion are captured; the provider and moderation prerequisites are not ready.
items.nextAction: After core community gates pass, test one bounded reading prompt before commissioning recurring clubs or programming.
items.doneWhen: The room supports safe, useful recommendations and discussion with source links, moderation, privacy and a demonstrated return reason.

items.title: Useful Tour Guide companion
items.currentTruth: A deterministic companion specification exists; the permanent character, verified catalogue, authored fact bank and live behavior are not built.
items.nextAction: Reconcile tour state and shared destination truth, select the character, build a small sourced fact bank and prototype quiet unobtrusive reactions on one page.
items.doneWhen: The optional guide answers where-to-find questions, offers verified discoveries and hands off substantive questions without covering content or inventing availability.
ideaLogClusters: Existing Tour Guide expanded into a reactive companion for discovery, facts and wayfinding

items.title: Town directory, building explanation and map
items.currentTruth: A canonical directory exists, but the visitor-facing explanation of town layout and each building's current offer has not reached an accepted coherent experience.
items.nextAction: Use the authoritative directory and approved building imagery to build one useful orientation surface; do not invent a fake town map or expose held destinations as available.
items.doneWhen: A first-time visitor can understand where things live and reach a relevant open destination without decoding internal architecture.

items.title: Portable listening and watching for episodes and songs
items.buildingOrFunction: Chick Flicks / KSVL / external media channels
items.currentTruth: The take-it-with-me requirement and channel options are specified; feeds, public channel release and continuous update propagation are not operational.
items.nextAction: Choose the canonical audio/video feeds and distribution sequence, prepare compliant masters/covers/metadata and prove website-to-platform version identity before publishing.
items.doneWhen: People can safely listen while driving or walking and watch through appropriate channels, with accessibility, rights, current versions and working links back to LAiDIES.

items.title: Media metadata, covers and correction propagation
items.currentTruth: A media release schema exists, but complete publisher-specific metadata, band/artist names, cover sets and update propagation are not proven end to end.
items.nextAction: Populate canonical episode and song release records, define platform mappings and make freshness corrections rebuild and republish every affected master/feed entry with receipts.
items.doneWhen: Every release has approved title, number, contributors, artist/band, artwork, descriptions, rights, captions/transcript, version and exact cross-channel update proof.

items.title: Weekly ingestion and distribution engine
items.currentTruth: The engine map and many controls exist, but complete recurring production, content propagation, media distribution and public verification are not one closed automatic cycle.
items.nextAction: Close the next real episode through every gate and consumer, including concepts, classes, books, cards, songs, Daily/social derivatives, media channels and correction propagation.
items.doneWhen: A weekly episode ships on schedule with exact approved assets, every required derivative/update, public discovery and a durable release receipt without hidden manual gaps.

items.title: Episode 5 and Super Models concept
items.currentTruth: The fashion analogy is a decided direction but exact episode scope and full production gates remain open.
items.nextAction: Complete the concept-fidelity matrix and ruled episode brief before script, storyboard, media and complement production.
items.doneWhen: The released episode accurately teaches its selected model concept, uses the analogy within its limits and ships every required learning/media derivative.
ideaLogClusters: Super Models fashion analogy for Episode 5

items.title: Social formats and Thursday Try-On
items.currentTruth: Format candidates exist, but the Audience/social source freeze and destination readiness gates prevent publishing or scheduling.
items.nextAction: Resolve the scoped recovery disposition, then bind each derivative to an exact approved destination, licensed/native media and measurement plan.
items.doneWhen: A weekly social cadence uses only approved public sources, drives useful actions, respects rights and records published—not merely built—truth and learning.

items.title: Secure mobile Control Room for a one-woman operation
items.currentTruth: A local dashboard and review inbox exist; secure remote access, authenticated actions, notifications and external data connections are not operational.
items.nextAction: Define the smallest secure remote architecture and action receipt model, then connect read-only health/schedule/review data before enabling approvals or mutations.
items.doneWhen: Ali can use laptop or phone to see site/agent/content/release/social/analytics/signup truth, review exact artifacts and issue bounded actions that return durable receipts.

items.title: Analytics, signups and evidence-backed recommendations
items.currentTruth: Visitors, signups, return behavior and page performance remain unknown where authorized aggregate sources or verified exports are absent.
items.nextAction: Connect approved privacy-safe aggregate analytics and Resident Card counts, define exposure-aware measures and feed ranked recommendations into the Control Room.
items.doneWhen: The dashboard distinguishes unknown from zero and shows source-dated visitors, new signups, return, journeys, popular/low-attention pages and actionable recommendations.

items.title: Ask residents what they want next
items.currentTruth: A poll idea exists, but its old timing is stale and it is not attached to a decision that results could change.
items.nextAction: Return when a real roadmap decision has bounded options; define audience, sampling, privacy and how results alter the decision.
items.doneWhen: A consented feedback mechanism informs a named choice and reports what was heard and what changed without pretending respondents represent everyone.
ideaLogSections: Ask Users What They Want Next

items.title: DJ JAIDY request experience
items.currentTruth: The request concept, stage name and tone examples are captured; rights, safety, production and request-service behavior are not specified.
items.nextAction: Return after core KSVL catalogue and request-service gates; define bounded inspiration inputs, style choices, moderation, rights and output ownership.
items.doneWhen: Residents can make safe song requests that produce clearly governed, rights-safe, catalogue-ready outcomes without targeting or harassing real people.

items.title: Founder-made merch and physical objects
items.currentTruth: Small-batch 3D-printed, embellished and one-off product ideas are captured; no offer, demand proof or fulfilment operation is approved.
items.nextAction: Return after the core site is stable and repeated demand exists; test one founder-made item with real cost, time, stock, fulfilment, accessibility, refund and IP evidence.
items.doneWhen: Any offer is real, voluntary, accurately described, fulfilment-ready and does not paywall learning or consume disproportionate founder time.

items.title: Reference Closet shop, watch, listen and read links
items.currentTruth: Use cases and disclosure guardrails are captured; core Closet, availability verification and commerce policies are not ready.
items.nextAction: After core Closet completion, define dated availability checks, affiliate disclosure, rights and a lesson-first card schema before adding one pilot link.
items.doneWhen: Links support a real learning/reference job, disclose relationships, remain current and never turn the Closet into a random storefront.

items.title: Sustainable revenue without pressure or paywalls
items.currentTruth: Anti-MLM, no-paywall and evidence-first principles are locked; no paid offer is live or authorized.
items.nextAction: Maintain the idea bank and cost baseline; activate only when a specific user value, demand signal, delivery cost, support/refund plan and Ali decision are evidence-ready.
items.doneWhen: A bounded offer passes trust, editorial independence, accessibility, fulfilment and sustainability gates without distorting learning or community behavior.
ideaLogClusters: Confident non-cringe growth, absolute anti-MLM boundary and future sustainable revenue

items.title: LAiDIES master and episode logo animation system
items.currentTruth: The exact master and Trailer/Episodes 01–04 animation mapping are approved locally; Homepage placement and insertion into episode masters remain separate work.
items.nextAction: Preserve the accepted animation and Homepage transition, then insert each approved episode ident into its correct master with reduced-motion/fallback and exact release proof.
items.doneWhen: The master and episode-specific idents appear in approved roles without crop, duplication or playback failure, and corrections propagate through the media release system.

items.title: Rewind Era reference canon intake
items.currentTruth: Zoolander, Jurassic Park and Polly Pocket are captured candidates, but no exact owner or approved teaching job admits a name to canon.
items.nextAction: Define the canon intake owner and evidence fields, then assess each candidate only against a ruled lesson, episode or brand job and the limits of its analogy.
items.doneWhen: Every used reference has an approved explanatory purpose, accurate analogy boundary, rights-safe treatment and consumers; unused names remain candidates, not canon.

items.title: TLDR / Hot Goss voice format
items.currentTruth: The phrase and five-part explanatory job are captured, but they cannot rename the four locked papers and no recurring package is accepted.
items.nextAction: Test the line as a limited label or recurring device inside a future NewsStand voice cycle; retain the locked publication names.
items.doneWhen: The format improves comprehension and LAiDIES voice without obscuring source status, publication role or correction behavior.

items.title: Butterfly Clip rating language and interaction
items.currentTruth: The broken-clip-to-ten scale and slider idea are captured, but no real feedback decision or non-currency semantic is assigned.
items.nextAction: Use only when a product owner has a real outcome to rate; separate decorative rating values from spendable Butterfly Clip balances.
items.doneWhen: The accessible interaction produces useful product evidence, uses you/we language correctly and cannot be confused with an economy grant.

items.title: Product Stewardship League and blocker escalation
items.currentTruth: Sixty-seven products are registered and validators pass, but owner-entry debt, external evidence connections and unresolved blockers remain.
items.nextAction: Use the portfolio inventory in each Control Room cycle, require exact unblock actions/review dates and surface only decision-ready Ali choices in the Action Centre.
items.doneWhen: Every product and initiative has a live owner/status/trigger, overdue blockers fail validation, accepted work produces visible outcomes and no lane disappears in prose.

items.title: Mutual-advancement culture across LAiDIES
items.buildingOrFunction: Community, LUMINAiRY and all editorial/learning surfaces
items.currentTruth: Ali's principle is explicit, but it is not yet a cross-site content and community standard with observable behaviors.
items.nextAction: Define the writing, moderation, recognition and product rules that reward credit, invitations, useful feedback, opportunity sharing and collective advancement while banning scarcity/competition framing.
items.doneWhen: Representative copy, community mechanics, recognition and moderation consistently help women include and advance one another without generic empowerment or confidence-deficit language.

items.title: Quotables, lyrics and memory hooks system
items.currentTruth: The system is specified and candidate lines exist, but the sitewide showcase, retrieval and exact source/rights controls are not complete.
items.nextAction: Inventory existing approved hooks and lyrics, link each to its concept and source, then expose them only where they strengthen recall and have current rights/provenance.
items.doneWhen: Useful hooks are searchable, non-duplicative, source-bound and measured for recall rather than repeated as decorative copy.
ideaLogClusters: Funny lines/lyrics/memory hooks surfaced across town

items.title: Behind the Build learning and correction system
items.currentTruth: A raw painpoint ledger and product specification exist; systematic conversion into tips, classes, posts and corrections is not fully operational.
items.nextAction: Route qualifying painpoints into the content work-order pipeline, decide the correct format and complete one public-quality example through review and discovery.
items.doneWhen: Reusable failures and fixes become accurate, useful LAiDIES learning only when evidence supports them, with private information removed and current practice verified.
ideaLogClusters: Behind-the-scenes learnings become useful LAiDIES tips/classes/posts

items.title: Terminal, PowerShell and command analogy
items.currentTruth: The secret-menu analogy is captured, but it is not a standalone product and its limits are not yet written.
items.nextAction: Use it only when a ruled lesson needs command-line vocabulary; explain where exact syntax, permissions and execution risk stop matching the menu analogy.
items.doneWhen: The selected content accurately explains the concept, boundaries and safe practice without implying hidden commands are harmless shortcuts.

items.title: Music videos for selected LAiDIES songs
items.currentTruth: The idea is accepted as a pilot candidate, but no song has a fully admitted master, rights, destination and approved visual grammar.
items.nextAction: Select one exact creator-confirmed song after its destination and rights pass, then commission a bounded video and independent media-quality review.
items.doneWhen: One music video has correct master audio, exact lyrics, artist metadata, cover/thumbnail, rights, accessible presentation and a working destination.

items.title: Dream Phone hallucination and verification game
items.currentTruth: A Dream Phone experience exists, but the intended game that helps distinguish hallucination from supported claims is not a fully accepted learning journey.
items.nextAction: Define claim/evidence rounds, explanations, safe source set, scoring and transfer outcome; build and test a complete representative game loop.
items.doneWhen: Players improve at checking claims and explaining why evidence supports or fails to support them, without the game presenting verdicts as professional advice.

items.title: FAiRY Godmother useful prompt and writing help
items.currentTruth: A recovered experience and typed answer-quality direction exist, but complete safety, retrieval, usefulness, reward and public gates remain open.
items.nextAction: Build the typed router, evidence/uncertainty behavior and concept handoffs; test real prompt/draft help, failure and privacy cases before hero promotion.
items.doneWhen: The tool reliably makes a provided prompt or draft clearer and more useful, explains enough to transfer, protects private/high-stakes use and charges Plays correctly.

items.title: Search, indexing, relationships and contradiction prevention
items.currentTruth: A relationship graph, work orders and resolution queue exist locally; all content is not yet comprehensively indexed, related and contradiction-checked through public release.
items.nextAction: Close the open resolution queue and require every new/corrected artifact to update search ingestion, related content, learn-more boxes, sitemap/feed metadata and conflicting consumers.
items.doneWhen: Readers can find content by task/concept, follow useful cross-format links and receive one coherent explanation across news, episodes, books, classes and tools.

items.title: Latest-since-your-visit and signed-in return experience
items.currentTruth: The Homepage job is defined, but personalized changes must not be claimed when the visitor is signed out and the ranking/suppression logic is not fully proven.
items.nextAction: Define first-visit, signed-out returning and signed-in returning states; cap and rank changes, use verified release dates and preserve privacy-safe continuation.
items.doneWhen: Visitors see a small relevant set rather than a giant missed-items list, and signed-in users can resume supported progress from authoritative state.

items.title: Resident Card, Closet and Wednesday Postcard move-in journey

items.currentTruth: The intended single-signup rule is clear: Postcard selected by default with an opt-out, plus a separate Postcard-only route; all provider and UI proof is not closed.

items.doneWhen: One resident signup creates the Card and selected Postcard subscription with visible opt-out, while Postcard-only signup works independently and every consent/delivery state is verified.

items.title: Daily mobile app or PWA opportunity
items.currentTruth: The opportunity is parked; a native app, PWA and mobile web have not been compared after the Daily and privacy-safe delivery contracts mature.
items.nextAction: When the recorded triggers pass, compare mobile web, PWA, native and no-app-yet against offline use, notifications, privacy, cost, maintenance and actual audience need.
items.doneWhen: Ali receives one evidence-ready platform recommendation with scope, cost, data flow, exit path and smallest reversible proof.

items.title: Model ignored my rule troubleshooting lesson
items.currentTruth: The Help! format candidate and instructional need are routed to Masterclass Lesson 4, but the mechanism, examples and mitigations are not yet authored.
items.nextAction: Write the concept brief for single-model and agent-system failures, map causes to mitigations and build controlled examples with outcome-level proof.
items.doneWhen: Learners can diagnose why rules were not followed, choose an appropriate mitigation and verify the actual result rather than trusting a repair report.
